title: Of Bricks and Patterns
description:
Bored with putting the same pieces in the same 10*20 grid ?

Of Bricks and Patterns allows you to fill dozens of different patterns, with dozens of different pieces !

What score will you reach ?

In this game, you have to fill patterns with pieces, to obtain the highest possible score.

Each pattern is divided into several parts, and filling one of them enough will grant you some doubled score-multiplier time.

Use it to score as much as you can !

If you manage to fill a new pattern part before your multiplier goes back to normal, your score multiplier is quadrupled !

You just completed two pattern parts with a single piece ?

Your multiplier is tenfold !

Every final score helps you to unlock new content.

You can then configure your next game just as you want it, by choosing among unlocked pieces, patterns, grids and skins.

Or let chance decide with the Lady Luck button.

There are dozens of pieces and patterns, as well as multiple grids and skins, and four difficulty modes awaiting you, for an infinite number of possibilities thanks to randomness !

Of Bricks and Patterns was created by a video games aficionado, for every player, allowing relaxing games, or demanding ones, according to your mood.

You can't lose, only get better by comparing your score to your best ones.

So, come fill patterns and reach sky-high scores in Of Bricks and Patterns !
